thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO breach detected on /v1/chat.stream — p99 latency 18s (SLO 5s) across us-east-1 for the last 10m. Paging oncall.

oncall-anya: on it. seeing alerts in paging channel. any initial customer impact?

incident-bot: ~3.2% of requests in the window returned streaming timeouts; error rate normal. affected routes show heavy preproc time.

rahul: I can pull traces. I'm seeing a spike in preproc.duration and tokenizer.duration, especially for requests with "json_mode": true and tool_schema nesting.

nina: confirming, our metrics show median preproc 120ms -> 1.8s, p95 2.6s -> 9.7s. tokenization tail hits p99 ~12s.

lisa: which deployments? hosted only or dedicated too?

morgan: primarily hosted us-east-1 clusters (runtime-prod-v3), a few dedicated pools with high template usage also degraded.

oncall-anya: ok, quick mitigation options: 1) temporarily disable JSON mode parsing for high-volume routes, 2) turn off streaming for endpoints hitting the tail, 3) divert traffic to fallback model variant with simpler prompt preprocessing. Which is quickest?

rahul: disable JSON mode on a route is a config flip in the gateway, can do a canary in 2m. stopping streaming requires client flag toggle, but we can coercively return non-streaming on the server by toggling streaming proxy. diverting traffic requires routing change and model availability.

nina: logs show a specific pattern — large prompt templates with embedded tool_schema arrays cause repeated tokenization passes. Example trace snippet:

```
preproc: build_prompt -> 1500 tokens
template.apply -> iterate tools[0..12]
tokenizer.vocab_lookup -> repeated substrings
preproc.duration: 9.2s
```

morgan: that matches a customer scenario where template expansion is run per-tool in a loop instead of a single concat. looks like a hot path regression from PR #4216 in template renderer.

oncall-anya: can we hotfix? rollback PR 4216 to staging?

rahul: rollback to previous renderer is doable but requires deploy and config propagation — estimate 12-18m to ramp.

lisa: what's the blast radius if we do the gateway flip (disable json_mode) vs rollback?

nina: gateway flip affects only requests that have json_mode=true; for many customers it's an opt-in. Impact: some customers will lose structured output capability (JSON parsing) temporarily. Rollback restores correctness for everyone but takes longer.

support-bot: top affected customers: acme-inc (5% of their requests hit json_mode), beta-app (heavy tool_schema use), and some internal evals. No major revenue-impacting customers in the list yet.

morgan: quick safety: we can enable a workload-specific prefix cache to avoid re-tokenizing identical prompt templates; that's a config change to preproc that can be applied to a subset of hosts in ~6m. It will reduce tokenization calls by ~70% for these routes.

oncall-anya: plan proposal: 1) Gateway: canary-disable json_mode for 5% traffic now. 2) Apply prefix-cache on two hot nodes (m3a,m3b) immediate. 3) If p99 still >8s after 10m, schedule rollback for renderer. Also shift streaming->non-streaming for the affected routes to reduce tail amplification.

rahul: executing step 1 now: `curl -X POST https://gateway/config/route/disable_json_mode -d '{"route":"/v1/chat.stream","percent":5}'`

devops-bot: config change accepted, rolling to 5% of gateway instances.

nina: monitoring panels updated. p95 dropped slightly to 4.8s in the canary shard, p99 still high in remainder.

morgan: applying prefix cache to m3a and m3b: `kubectl set env deploy/preproc CACHE_PREFIX=enabled --namespace=runtime-prod`. Doing m3a now.

devops-bot: m3a update success, m3b in progress.

lisa: support: ping acme-inc and beta-app with temporary workaround note?

support-bot: message queued to ACME/ops and Beta-app escalation channels: "We are investigating increased latency on streaming endpoints. As a temporary mitigation we may disable structured JSON outputs for a small portion of traffic; we will follow up with timeline."

oncall-anya: after both prefix nodes updated, p95 improved to 3.1s across canary, p99 at 6.2s overall. Good progress.

rahul: we still see some long tails tied to specific templates that iterate tools heavily. I can craft a targeted rate-limit for templates exceeding token threshold ( > 2k tokens ) to shed load.

morgan: also recommend we add a fast-path in template renderer to pre-concatenate tool schemas instead of per-tool rendering — that's a medium-term fix (PR + test).

oncall-anya: decision: 1) complete gateway flip to 50% now, 2) apply rate-limit for >2k token templates on gateway and 3) schedule rollback if next 15m doesn't stabilize.

rahul: executing gateway increase to 50% and adding rate-limit rule: `gatewayctl set rate-limit --route '/v1/chat.stream' --expr 'template_tokens > 2000' --limit 10r/s`. Applying.

devops-bot: rate-limit applied. Gateway now at 50% json_mode-off for the route.

nina: metrics at +6m: p95 2.7s, p99 4.4s, streaming timeout count down 80%. Customer impact noticeably reduced.

morgan: log sample from remaining slow request shows repeated `json_mode: true` parsing for nested schemas — these are the ones blocked by rate-limit.

lisa: good. let's keep oncall and support notes active. Rahul, can you start preparing rollback runbook in case we need it?

rahul: will prepare steps and test plan. If we need to rollback renderer PR 4216: tag `renderer:v2.8.3` -> deploy -> smoke tests. Estimated 15m deploy time.

oncall-anya: handoff note for next oncall in 30m: ongoing mitigations: gateway json_mode partial disable, prefix-cache enabled on two nodes, heavy-template rate-limit in place. Monitor p99 and streaming timeouts. Support to follow up with affected customers. If p99 >6s after rollback attempt or mitigations don't reduce tail, escalate to infra-eng.

support-bot: dispatching incident summary to #customer-impact and creating incident ticket INC-2023-4729.

morgan: will open a postmortem draft and link template-renderer PR to triage. Suspect root cause: unguarded loop in renderer change leading to O(N^2) tokenization for complex tool_schema arrays.

oncall-anya: thanks team. keep updates in this thread. I'll sign out to dinner in 25m but will hand over to rahul. :thumbsup:

rahul: taking handoff. will keep watch and coordinate rollback plan if needed.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations applied. Monitoring will continue.

-- end of thread --
